measurements.particle_name: PS size standards (0.1, 1, 5 μm), before UV sterilisation

conditions.instrument: Malvern Zetasizer Nano ZS, A. P. Instruments

measurements.evidence_quote: Dynamic light scattering (DLS) measurements (Malvern Zetasizer Nano ZS, A. P. Instruments) of average diameter, polydispersity index, and ζ-potential, taken before and after UV irradiation, indicated no effect of the sterilization procedure on these parameters.
